scope: Read-only diagnostic; no app/test production edits by diagnostic agent.

largestAvbIsolatedRepeats.method: Largest AVB by file size, 01_SEQ.avb; three additional isolated fresh-process pairs after all app builds and tests finished. Orders: before/after, after/before, before/after. QT_HASH_SEED=0. Parsed physical footprint and peak resident memory captured immediately after reading, before any hashing, indexing, projection or graph counting.

hashMethod: QDataStream Qt_6_0, big-endian, streamed through a bounded 64 KB SHA256 sink. All declared ParsedSource fields recursively, including source receipts, record sets, objects, raw properties, decoded QVariants, read/text encoding/basis flags, native contexts, locators, framing/ranges, ordered relationships/references and diagnostics. Complete PMR/OMF projection file/master IDs, object references, observations, coverage and read/selected states. AVB sequence candidates and whole-bin, all-selected and each-selected-sequence resolutions, including ordered roots, edges, media, terminals, issues, completeness and cancellation. Hash-map keys sorted; QT_HASH_SEED=0 in both modes. Pointer addresses and capacities excluded from semantic digests.
storageMethod: For each ParsedSource recursively: counts, capacities and element sizes of object properties, unowned properties, objects, relationships, record sets, record-set object handles, embedded children and diagnostics. Requested slot bytes = capacity * sizeof(element). This measures neither actual malloc bucket sizes nor process RAM nor deep string/byte/context allocations.
sourceStampMethod: Exact size, modification timestamp in nanoseconds, device/inode and absolute path before each pair; rechecked after the pair and unchanged for all 105 sources and all three isolated AVB pairs.
build: Qt 6.5.3, C++17; before copied Canon Debug library with only MDB/OMF property compaction versus final Canon Debug library with shared source-storage helper. Diagnostic compiled arm64 with -O2.
limitations: Real unchanged specimens, not a guarantee for every possible file.
Initial 105-pair timings and footprints are supplementary because app builds/tests ran concurrently; isolated AVB repeats are identified separately.
AVB resolution uses one loaded bin at a time. All issues and partial results are retained identically; this is not a claim of complete dependency coverage.
Pointer-sharing topology is not hashed; pointed-to receipt/context contents are included.
Requested slot reductions cannot be added to claim process-footprint reductions; allocation behavior changes.
The largest AVB settled parsed footprint falls, but its transient peak resident memory and reading time rise; report all three.
Full managed-media scan outputs and scheduling are compared separately by the root agent.
